Duas.SubHeading: Fall asleep under Allah’s protection and mercy.
Duas.Translation: O Allah, in Your name I die and I live.

Duas.SubHeading: Wake up with gratitude and renewed blessings
Duas.arabic: الْـحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
Duas.Translation: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after causing us to die, and to Him is the resurrection.
Duas.Transliteration: Alhamdu lillahi alladhi ahyana ba’da ma amatana wa ilayhi an-nushoor

Duas.SubHeading: Invite barakah and safety into your home
Duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
Duas.Translation: In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we place our trust.
Duas.Transliteration: Bismillahi walajna wa bismillahi kharajna wa alallahi rabbina tawakkalna

Duas.SubHeading: Step out shielded by His protection
Duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
Duas.Translation: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no power nor strength except with Allah.
Duas.Transliteration: Bismillahi tawakkaltu alallah wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah

Duas.SubHeading: Seek protection from harm and impurity
Duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
Duas.Translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from male and female devils.
Duas.Transliteration: Allahumma inni a’udhu bika minal khubuthi wal khabaith

Duas.SubHeading: Step out with purity and praise to Allah
